en_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a Huge Success for Nintendo — And Just Broke a Switch 2 Sales Record
cn_title: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》为任天堂取得巨大成功，并刚刚打破一项Switch 2销量纪录
opus_summary: 任天堂宣布，《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版上市首四天售出520万份，创下Switch 2游戏同期最快销售纪录，超过《咚奇刚 蕉力全开》《宝可梦Pokopia》和《马力欧卡丁车世界》等作品。

paragraphs.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has broken sales records for Nintendo, and become the fastest-selling Switch 2 game over its first four days of availability.
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》打破了任天堂的销量纪录，成为发售头四天销售速度最快的Switch 2游戏。

paragraphs.en: Nintendo has already shifted 5.2 million copies of its newly-launched Zelda remake, the company announced today in a celebratory press release.
paragraphs.cn: 任天堂今天在一份庆祝新闻稿中宣布，旗下新推出的《塞尔达传说》重制版销量已达520万份。

paragraphs.en: That means Zelda is selling faster than other notable Switch 2 arrivals such as Donkey Kong Bananza, Pokémon Pokopia and even Mario Kart World, which launched alongside the console last year. (Nintendo sold 3.5 million Switch 2 consoles over its first four days, with roughly 80% of those consoles sold in a bundle with Mario Kart World, at least in the U.S.)
paragraphs.cn: 这意味着，《塞尔达传说》的销售速度超过了其他备受关注的Switch 2新作，例如《咚奇刚 蕉力全开》《宝可梦Pokopia》，甚至超过了去年与主机同步发售的《马力欧卡丁车世界》。（任天堂在发售头四天售出了350万台Switch 2，至少在美国，这些主机中约有80%以《马力欧卡丁车世界》同捆套装的形式售出。）

paragraphs.en: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is Nintendo's big Switch 2 game for the holidays, so the firm will likely be pleased by its strong launch. It is one of the few other titles (hello, Barbie!) braving a November release, just a few weeks clear of this year (and decade)'s hugely-hyped arrival of Grand Theft Auto 6. But perhaps the firm has been wise to bet on Ocarina of Time's legendary status and broad audience being distinct enough to survive GTA's gravitational pull.
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》是任天堂在假日季推出的重磅Switch 2游戏，因此该公司可能会对其强劲的首发表现感到满意。它是少数敢于在11月发售的其他作品之一（你好，《Barbie》！），与今年（乃至这十年）备受热炒的《GTA6》发售仅隔几周。不过，任天堂或许押对了宝：凭借《塞尔达传说 时之笛》的传奇地位和广泛受众，它足够与众不同，能够在《侠盗猎车手》的强大吸引力下生存。

paragraphs.en: Originally released for the N64 back in 1998, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remains one of the highest-rated and most beloved games of all time. You can read our review of the remake here , or check out our look at the Biggest Changes from the original 1998 game. Be sure to check out our expanding Ocarina of Time Remake Walkthrough for comprehensive guides on each main quest area and dungeon, plus where to get Early Heart Pieces, Early Gold Skulltulas , and Early Item Bag Expansions . If you’re looking for more, don’t miss our complete guides to All Pieces of Heart , All Gold Skulltulas , and All Empty Bottles !
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》最初于1998年在N64上发售，至今仍是有史以来评分最高、最受喜爱的游戏之一。你可以在这里阅读我们对重制版的评测，或查看我们对它与1998年原版游戏之间最大变化的介绍。一定要看看我们不断扩充的《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版流程攻略，其中包含每个主线任务区域和地牢的全面指南，以及前期心之碎片、前期黄金蜘蛛和前期道具袋扩容的获取位置。如果你还想了解更多，不要错过我们关于全部心之碎片、全部黄金蜘蛛和全部空瓶的完整指南！
